response.sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, v.points_won FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id), group_avgs AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_avgs) AS diff_from_mean_of_group_avgs FROM group_avgs ORDER BY death_country;

assumptions.assumption: 'Award vote records' means player_award_vote, the only vote table with a foreign key to player. manager_award_vote is excluded.
A blank death_country is NULL, empty, or whitespace-only. All blank values form one group whose death_country is shown as ''. Non-blank values are not trimmed.
The inner JOIN drops votes whose player_id has no match in player, as the request asks.
AVG ignores NULL points_won, so a group whose points_won values are all NULL gets a NULL average and is left out of the mean of group averages.
'How far' is the signed difference: group average minus the simple mean of all group averages. Averages are not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat manager award votes as award vote records too: combine player_award_vote and manager_award_vote (both keyed by player_id), then apply the same grouping and difference calculation.
alternatives.sql: WITH all_votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote), votes AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, v.points_won FROM all_votes v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id), group_avgs AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_avgs) AS diff_from_mean_of_group_avgs FROM group_avgs ORDER BY death_country;
